title: Host-only work core operations still act on an unheld focus when the session holds other work
outcome: Host-only work core operations still act on an unheld focus when the session holds other work
acceptance: Tests cover each ambient core form after add while another item is held

The ambient forms of the host-only work core operations (decompose under focus, checkpoint and evidence capture, update) apply the same implicit-target rule as the agent words: when the focus is not held by the session while it holds other live claims, they refuse with work_implicit_target_conflict and record nothing

completion.summary: Landed in ee20fd7: ambient core operations (decompose with no named parent, every work core update form with no named item) refuse with work_implicit_target_conflict and record nothing when the focus is unheld while other work is held; admitted retries (same key and intent, finished or core-committed) still replay or recover.
